title: Bound the retryable "authority still being confirmed" refusal of an acceptance submission when settlement can never succeed
outcome: An evaluator's submission that meets an unconfirmed naming authority is told to submit again only while a resubmission can still settle it. When settlement fails for a structural reason (no authority owner, no authorized reader in the store, a stopped persist writer), or after a bounded number of attempts, it gets a terminal refusal the parent can act on.
acceptance: Bound the retryable "authority still being confirmed" refusal of an acceptance submission when settlement can never succeed is done
